_comment: The keys an OpenStack or RHOSO provider's check reports (SDD §10): a destination's adds §10.1's destination_release keys and its GPU capacity (gpu_capacity, SDD §22.3); `vmware` lists a vCenter's (review PV-06). Shared by seamless/tests/test_providers.py (the real check through keystoneauth and the demo's fakes report these; the real check leaves roles out when it cannot read the token's roles, and NET_PORT_NOT_PERMITTED then judges no role half, SDD §9.3) and dashboard/src/api/mock.test.ts (the mock's check reports them too, plan T8).
